goal.zh: 让参会成员对会议结论与后续行动形成一致理解。
goal.en: Give participants a shared understanding of the meeting decisions and next actions.

records.纪要包含会议议题、关键结论和待解决问题，并共享给参会成员。: Share minutes covering topics, decisions and unresolved questions. Record an owner and agreed date for each action and confirm them with participants.
records.先从会议记录提取议题、决定与待办，再逐项核对行动负责人和时间；将有歧义的结论标出: Extract topics, decisions and actions from the meeting notes. Verify owners and dates, and ask participants to clarify ambiguous conclusions.

title.zh: 新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Coordinate the Douyin creator campaign for a September 15 launch and GMV of 500,000, covering creators, content, operations, inventory, advertising, data and compliance.

records.9 月 15 日按已确认排期上线，商品、达人内容与履约准备就绪。: Launch on September 15 with approved content and fulfillment ready. Reach GMV of 500,000 and deliver verifiable sales data and a retrospective.
records.先确认 GMV 的统计周期和退款口径，再协调达人排期与备货；上线前统一核对素材、: Confirm the GMV measurement and refund window. Coordinate creator availability and inventory, then check assets, links, promotions and fulfillment before launch.

title.zh: 筛选达人并确认商务合作

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Secure suitable creators for the product campaign.

records.交付已确认合作的达人名单、报价、排期及合作协议。: Deliver the confirmed creator list, commercial terms, agreements and schedule.
records.按受众匹配度和历史履约筛选达人，逐项确认报价、佣金、授权与排期，并保留书面合作记: Screen audience fit and past delivery. Confirm fees, commissions, usage rights and availability in writing.

title.zh: 完成卖点、脚本与直播素材

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Provide accurate, approved promotional content for creators.

records.交付通过审核的卖点文案、直播脚本及可用素材。: Deliver approved selling-point copy, livestream scripts and usable campaign assets.
records.先核实卖点和宣称依据，再编排口播、演示与互动环节；脚本和直播素材使用同一审核版本: Verify claims before drafting. Keep scripts, demonstrations and assets on the same approved version.

title.zh: 完成直播彩排与上线执行

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Publish on schedule and resolve operational issues promptly.

records.完成彩排和问题闭环，按确认排期上线并留存执行记录。: Complete the rehearsal, close issues, publish on the confirmed schedule and retain execution records.
records.按真实流程完成彩排，记录并关闭问题；上线前复核链接、优惠、库存与值守安排。: Test links, promotions and inventory before release. Record incidents, owners and recovery times while monitoring the launch.

title.zh: 确认价格机制、库存与履约

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Keep product offers accurate and customer orders fulfillable.

records.确认最终价格及优惠配置，备货、发货与售后方案可执行。: Confirm final prices, promotion settings, stock, shipping and after-sales arrangements.
records.逐项核对价格、赠品和优惠叠加规则，确认可售库存及发货时效，并准备缺货和退换货方案: Check promotion stacking, sellable inventory and shipping times. Prepare responses to stockouts, returns and exchanges.

title.zh: 制定投流计划并控制 ROI

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Reach the intended audience within the agreed budget and ROI measurement.

records.交付确认后的投流计划和执行记录，ROI 按约定口径核对。: Deliver the approved media plan and execution records, with ROI checked using the agreed method.
records.先统一 ROI 口径和预算上限，再配置人群与素材测试；设置检查频率和止损条件，保: Agree budget limits and ROI definitions. Test audiences and assets, set review frequency and stopping conditions, and record adjustments.

title.zh: 搭建数据看板并完成复盘

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Understand campaign results and define improvements for the next round.

records.销售与投流数据可核对，复盘包含结论、问题及后续行动。: Deliver reconciled sales and advertising data, findings, issues and follow-up actions.
records.统一交易、退款和归因窗口后核对各渠道数据，复盘差异原因，并明确下一轮行动及负责人: Align refund and attribution windows before comparing channels. Turn findings into actions with owners and deadlines.

title.zh: 完成素材宣称与合同合规审核

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Ensure campaign assets and agreements satisfy the applicable requirements.

records.交付素材与合同审核记录，需整改事项在上线前关闭。: Deliver asset and contract review records. Close required corrections before launch.
records.逐项检查功效宣称、素材授权和合同义务，标出需修改的内容；整改后复核并归档确认版本: Check claims, licenses and contractual obligations. Recheck corrections and archive the approved versions.

goal.zh: 完成达人合作、内容制作与上线复盘，推动新品销售。
goal.en: Complete creator partnerships, content production, launch and review to support product sales.

records.合作与内容交付通过验收，完成上线执行并交付效果复盘。: Accept partnership and content deliverables, execute the launch and deliver the results review.
records.先对齐推广范围、销售统计口径与上线排期，再协调商务、内容和履约；上线前集中核对各: Align campaign scope, sales measurement and launch dates before coordinating commercial, content and fulfillment work.

goal.zh: 确保合适的达人按约定参与新品推广。
goal.en: Secure suitable creators for the product campaign.

records.交付已确认的达人名单、合作条款与排期。: Deliver the confirmed creator list, commercial terms, agreements and schedule.
records.按受众匹配度和历史履约情况筛选达人，逐项确认报价、佣金、素材授权与档期，并保留书: Screen audience fit and past delivery. Confirm fees, commissions, usage rights and availability in writing.

goal.zh: 提供能够准确传达新品价值的推广内容。
goal.en: Communicate the new product’s value accurately.

records.脚本与视频素材通过审核，可用于上线。: Approve scripts and video assets for launch.
records.先确认卖点及宣称依据，再推进脚本和拍摄；统一版本与审核人，避免脚本、商品信息和成: Confirm claims first, then coordinate writing and filming using one approved version and designated reviewers.

goal.zh: 让主播准确传达卖点并完成直播转化引导。
goal.en: Help presenters explain selling points and guide purchases accurately.

records.商品卖点与直播脚本通过审核。: Approve the product selling points and livestream script.
records.将已核实卖点整理成讲解顺序，明确演示、互动和转化节点；与主播试读后再定稿。: Turn verified selling points into a clear sequence of demonstrations, interactions and conversion guidance. Read through it with the presenter.

goal.zh: 明确可验证的产品价值，为脚本提供依据。
goal.en: Give the script a clear basis in verifiable product value.

records.交付已核对的核心卖点与证明材料。: Deliver verified selling points and supporting evidence.
records.逐条关联产品参数、使用场景与证明材料，区分可公开宣称和待核实信息，优先保留受众最: Connect each claim to product specifications and evidence. Separate approved claims from information that still needs verification.

goal.zh: 让直播流程、商品讲解和互动引导可执行。
goal.en: Make product demonstrations, interactions and purchase guidance executable.

records.交付通过审核的直播流程、口播与互动脚本。: Deliver approved scripts covering the livestream flow, spoken content and interactions.
records.按开场、演示、答疑和下单引导编排脚本，标注时长、优惠条件与禁用表述，并预留缺货和: Sequence the opening, demonstrations, questions and purchase guidance. Include timing, promotion conditions and fallback responses.

goal.zh: 提供可直接发布的新品推广视频。
goal.en: Provide campaign videos ready for publication.

records.交付通过审核、规格符合发布要求的视频素材。: Deliver approved videos that meet the publishing specifications.
records.按确认脚本准备分镜和样品，拍摄前检查画幅、收音与光线；交付时同步字幕、封面和素材: Prepare storyboards and samples. Check framing, audio and lighting, then deliver captions, covers and usage rights with the videos.

goal.zh: 确保活动顺利上线并沉淀可复用的经验。
goal.en: Launch successfully and retain lessons for future campaigns.

records.上线执行完成，数据可核对，复盘结论明确。: Complete launch operations, reconcile data and document clear review findings.
records.上线前统一核对链接、价格、库存与排期，明确值守和异常联系人；按同一统计窗口收集数: Check links, prices, inventory and schedules. Assign monitoring contacts and collect data over one consistent measurement window.

goal.zh: 按确认排期完成发布并及时处理现场问题。
goal.en: Publish on schedule and resolve operational issues promptly.

records.完成发布检查与上线值守，留存执行记录。: Complete the rehearsal, close issues, publish on the confirmed schedule and retain execution records.
records.发布前完成链接和优惠测试，按检查清单逐项放行；值守期间记录异常、处理人和恢复时间: Test links, promotions and inventory before release. Record incidents, owners and recovery times while monitoring the launch.

goal.zh: 明确活动效果与下一轮需要改进的行动。
goal.en: Understand campaign results and define improvements for the next round.

records.交付核对后的销售数据、效果分析与后续行动。: Deliver reconciled sales and advertising data, findings, issues and follow-up actions.
records.统一退款和归因口径后核对销售与投流数据，比较各达人和内容表现，将问题转化为有负责: Align refund and attribution windows before comparing channels. Turn findings into actions with owners and deadlines.

goal.zh: 汇总新品发布结果、关键数据、问题和后续行动，形成可共享的专项复盘。
goal.en: Summarize launch outcomes, key data, issues and next actions in a shared review.

records.交付专项复盘，包含发布结果、关键数据、问题和后续行动。: Deliver a focused retrospective covering results, data, problems and next actions.
records.先核对已有复盘的范围与数据窗口，重点补充本次专项问题、原因和改进行动，避免重复记: Check the scope and data window of existing reviews. Add the specific causes and improvements from this launch without duplicating conclusions.

title.zh: 整理并确认媒体邀请名单

goal.zh: 完成目标媒体筛选、联系人核对、邀请状态跟进，并在发布会前确认最终出席名单。
goal.en: Verify target media, contacts and invitation status, and confirm attendees before the launch.

records.交付已核对的媒体邀请名单，含联系人、邀请状态与出席确认。: Deliver a verified media list with contact details, invitation status and attendance confirmations.
records.从现有媒体名单开始去重，逐项核对联系人、邀请渠道和出席状态；未回复与已确认名单分: Deduplicate the existing list and verify contacts and channels. Track pending replies separately from confirmed attendees.

title.zh: 完成办公室无线网络部署

goal.zh: 让办公室会议与日常办公保持稳定联网。
goal.en: Provide stable connectivity for office work and meetings.

records.无线网络覆盖全部办公区域，连接测试通过并记录网络配置。: Cover every office area, pass connection and video meeting tests, and deliver network configuration, usage and troubleshooting notes.
records.先核对办公区域、终端数量和现有网络设备，再分区配置与测试；保留配置记录并验证会议: Check coverage areas, device counts and existing equipment. Configure and test each area, retain configuration records and verify recovery procedures.
